asr.full_text: well Happy Saturday to you Chris Hare here the world champion crypto cowboy bringing you an update on polka dot today and the question begs it's been going down for a pretty good while now it's had that huge wick after the flash crash so what in the world is happening with polka dot where is it going where's it going when it hits bottom where is the bottom well we're gonna sort it out today we're gonna start off in a weekly chart and figure out where that macro bottom is then I'm to work down and give you some pretty pinpoint targets on where I think it's going and what happens next. So let's get into it. Without further ado, we'll start off with the crypto fear and greed index currently sitting at 24. We came down just a little bit. We were around 28 yesterday. This measures market sentiment. It tells us if people are scared, if are greedy what's going on but i used to make small spot purchases when we go into fear and when we go into extreme fear i buy just a little more it works very well for my spot bags it's a strategy that i've used and it works pretty well i'm not on a time frame for it because it's spot and i use larger cap coins so i don't have to worry about them going to zero but you can see i pulled up a bit btcc exchange i've dollar cost averaged about 300 dollars so far into bitcoin ethereum and solana and we're up up a whopping dollar 33 it's probably going to retreat a little bit but i'm not worried about it if we drop into extreme fear again i'll just buy a little more it's a pretty strategy, it works really good but if you need an exchange to trade on I always recommend having more than one. BTCC is outstanding, there's no KYC, they're offering a huge promotion right now that gets you 10% back on your deposit bonuses up to $100,000. So if you put $100,000 in you get $10,000 back, you get really good trading fees using my link you'll find in the description so go ahead and check it out if nothing else go get you some free money moving on to an altcoin season index because it's relevant to polka dot we're in a 37 we've came up just a little bit it was down at around 31. and when i get into the charts i'm gonna show you something interesting that i see and it makes me wonder if we're not getting close to a bottom I feel like all coins have been in a bear market since about January of this year so I think we've got a lot to talk about I think we've got a lot to sort out we'll start off with a liquidation heatmap I look at these before I ever open a trade it's where I start my trading system because market makers track liquidity. They don't really use TA, they just go to where your liquidation points are, your long trades and your short trades are the long accumulation and short accumulation, they just chase them up and down, that's how the charts move. You can see right now on a weekly chart, everything above price action is a short trade, everything below price action is a long trade and cumulatively we've got about nine million dollars worth of short trades on the books to the long side we've got about two and a half million so the imbalance is definitely to the upside but you can see these bright pockets right here around two dollars all the way down here to about a dollar 48 i kind of feel like that's where we're going but we'll break it down into charts, we'll figure it out. I'll post all these charts in the crypto school. You'll find a link to that in my description. Great lineup of coaches. You'll have direct access to me. We post signals there, I posted some shorts of over the past couple of days that have absolutely printed, but we're gonna start off with a weekly chart on Polkadot because I think we need to tell the story before we get there. You can see we've been in this downtrend ever since about the flash since before the flash crash right around october 2nd and pardon the dogs they don't know how to shut up and then we had the big wick that came about on october 6 during that flash crash on friday and we just kind of started filling it out market makers typically like to fill about 50 to 80% of these out. So that puts us down here around a dollar 17 to a dollar 50. I showed you the weekly chart first because the lower time frames kind of sort this out and give us more of a pinpoint bottom. But eventually we've got to come up. I don't think we go below this wick, but it remains to be seen. But then we'll work up and we'll figure out the targets. I think at some point you go back to revisit $7.66 to $9.57 and $15 to $19. Moving out to the daily chart, it's going to break this down move down a little more. You see, we've came down all the way into this daily retracement zone. The 7.86 sits at about a $1.54. That puts us halfway down on that wick. I'm not sure that we don't go much below this. If we do, then I think you're looking at 60, 70 cents but we may be able to hang on here and then work our way up. 329 to 401, 609 to 757. Looking at a four hour chart, it breaks that wick down in what we're trying to figure out just a little bit more you can see we've lost this four-hour retracement zone right now we're losing it about two or four we're sitting at about two or three and a half right now so your next stop is probably going to be around the dollar 81 to a dollar 65 we set in a lower low so what happens on these sometimes it's they call it like a wxy in elliot wave theory so there is a possibility that we find support here work up to this red fair value gap around 219 before we reject down come on down that one to dollar 81 and a dollar 65. i don't think we're ready for a run-up yet bitcoin looks like it's got some more downside to it so that's kind of where i'm at in the shorter term you can see we've lost the fifty moving averages on the hourly that takes 50 of these candles puts a fluid line on the chart works as support and resistance we're trying to reclaim the 50 simple moving average right now but you've got two big red fair value gaps right up here i think you reject this and come on down 181 to 166 i think your target's it for some reason we can get above this and start working up i think 222 to 229 is your first stop then up to 252 to 268 but like i said my bias is down this looks like a liquidity sweep to me and what these do is they just roll over and then they start working their way down so i'm still looking at these bottom targets and i think we've got to fill out that wick before we find that actual bottom and start moving up that gives you a pretty good idea what's going on and it's pretty cut and dry i think of where we're headed and what's going on when we get to the bottom or find some kind of support i'll circle back around do another video on this and we'll figure out where those upside targets are but i'm gonna wrap this one up for tonight for today don't forget to check out all the links and like and subscribe, tap the bell notification. You'll get updates as soon as I upload a video and leave us a comment. It helps the YouTube algorithm and I really enjoy hearing from you people. But I'm going to wrap it up, get back out there, get some work done. My name is Chris Hare, the world champion crypto cowboy. Thanks so much for watching and we'll see you down the road.
